description: TypeScript-only construct that emits a runtime object. Numeric enums have reverse mappings; string enums are nominal.
Enum whose members are inlined at compile time. Fragile with single-file transpilers and `isolatedModules`.
TypeScript 5.8 option that rejects syntax that cannot simply be stripped: enums, namespaces with values and parameter properties.
Erasable replacement for enums: `const X = {...} as const; type X = (typeof X)[keyof typeof X];`
